title: SafeDSE: Joint Exploration of Safety Architecture Patterns, Mapping, and Scheduling for Dataflow Applications With Safety Arguments (Extended Version)
abstract: arXiv:2610.16213v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embedded platforms increasingly host safety-related streaming functions next to less critical ones. Whether a safety architecture pattern, such as a doer/checker pair, protects a function depends on the cores that run its components. Their schedule must meet the throughput requirement, and mixing safety integrity levels (SILs) on one core raises development cost. This report presents SafeDSE, a design space exploration framework for synchronous dataflow applications. One declarative constraint model decides the pattern of each actor, the placement that the fault model requires, the static-order schedule, and the platform, and prices SIL promotion. Guards activate the chosen patterns in a fixed graph that holds all of them, and node potentials encode throughput. translated_title: SafeDSE：面向具有安全论证的数据流应用的安全架构模式、映射与调度的联合探索（扩展版）
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.16213v1 公告类型：交叉发布（cross）摘要：嵌入式平台越来越多地在同一平台上同时承载安全相关的流式功能与关键性较低的功能。某种安全架构模式（如执行者/检查者对，doer/checker pair）能否保护某个功能，取决于运行其组件的处理器核。其调度必须满足吞吐量要求，而在同一处理器核上混合不同安全完整性等级会提高开发成本。本报告提出了SafeDSE，一个面向同步数据流应用的设计空间探索框架。一个声明式约束模型同时决定每个参与者的模式选择、故障模型所要求的放置方式、静态顺序调度以及目标平台，并对SIL（安全完整性等级）提升进行定价。通过守卫在一个包含所有模式的固定图中激活所选模式，节点势用于编码吞吐量。一个独立的验证器会重新检查每一个解，并由生成器将其检查结果转化为以目标结构化表示法表达的安全论证证据。在9个基准实例上（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: SafeDSE提出了一个基于声明式约束模型的设计空间探索框架，对同步数据流应用的安全架构模式、映射、调度与平台选择进行联合优化，并通过独立验证器和目标结构化表示法自动生成安全论证证据。
en_tdlr: SafeDSE is a design space exploration framework that jointly explores safety architecture patterns, mapping, scheduling, and platform selection for synchronous dataflow applications using a single declarative constraint model, with an independent verifier and a generator producing safety argument evidence in Goal Structuring Notation.
